pure-announcement.rationale: It is a scrape of the ATT&CK site's navigation matrix, not an announcement of any kind.

duplicate.rationale: No existing concept covers the ATT&CK framework; the supplied neighbours are MCP-governance and visibility notes.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The capture makes no claims to falsify — it is 4,100 lines of tactic and technique links, each trivially checkable against attack.mitre.org.

durability.rationale: What was captured is a version-pinned enumeration of technique IDs that drifts with every ATT&CK release, and none of the framework's durable explanatory content (what a tactic is, how the taxonomy is meant to be used) made it into the note.

actionability.rationale: The note contains only bare navigation links — no technique descriptions, no usage guidance, nothing a reader could build or decide from without leaving for the live site.

atomicity.rationale: There is no statable core idea in the capture at all — it is an index page's link tree, not prose from which a one-paragraph concept could be drawn.
